The unnecessary step is **the patient reclined at 45° with the head turned to the opposite side**, because the JVP only needs a reclined position of roughly 30–45°, and head rotation is an optional refinement. A relaxed neck is essential, since tension obscures the venous column. This supersedes my earlier answer about palpation, which was not one of the team's options. I'm not certain, because both choices are standard positioning advice.

CONFIDENCE: 45
